questions.question: Five family members K, L, M, N and O went for a picnic. There is at least one couple at the picnic. O is a male. M is the grandfather of N. K is the mother of L who is the grandson of M. How is O related to N?
questions.questionHtml: Five family members K, L, M, N and O went for a picnic. There is at least one couple at the picnic. O is a male. M is the grandfather of N. K is the mother of L who is the grandson of M. How is O related to N?
questions.solution:
From the given information


 

1) M is the grandfather of N.

2) K is the mother of L who is the grandson of M implies that L is the brother of N.

3) O is a male.

4) There is at least one couple at the picnic implies that O must be the husband of K.

Hence O is the father of N.

questions.question: K is married to L. M is the son of L. N is the brother of M. O is the daughter of M and married to P. Q is the mother of M's mother who has only one daughter L. R is married to Q. How is R related to K?
questions.questionHtml: K is married to L. M is the son of L. N is the brother of M. O is the daughter of M and married to P. Q is the mother of M's mother who has only one daughter L. R is married to Q. How is R related to K?
questions.solution: R is wife's father of K.

questions.solution:
According to the given information:

  • Parth is Aanya's maternal uncle.
  • Poonam is the mother of Aanya.
  • Varun is Poonam's husband.

  • Alok is the paternal grandfather of Aanya.

  • Varun is the son-in-law of Rina.
  • Luv is the husband of Rina.
  • Luv has two children.

​This is the final diagram that can be deduced

From the diagram, we can see Luv is Varun's wife's father.

Thus, Varun is Luv's Son-in-law.

​Hence, the correct answer is "Son-in-law".
